avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Induces CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, reducing venlafaxine levels; increases serotonin independently, risk of serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; do not use concurrently. Discontinue St. John's Wort before starting venlafaxine or allow 2-week washout.

avoid_supplements.name: 5-HTP
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Direct serotonergic activity increases serotonin syndrome risk when combined with venlafaxine's SNRI mechanism
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; counsel patient on serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, confusion, rapid heart rate, high BP, hyperthermia).

avoid_supplements.name: L-Tryptophan
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Precursor to serotonin; combined with venlafaxine increases central serotonin levels excessively
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; obtain tryptophan from dietary sources only if needed.

avoid_supplements.name: SAMe (S-Adenosyl Methionine)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Enhances serotonergic and noradrenergic neurotransmission, additive effects with venlafaxine
avoid_supplements.action: Contraindicated; discontinue before initiating venlafaxine therapy.

avoid_supplements.name: MAOI-containing supplements (e.g., Yohimbe)
avoid_supplements.mechanism: MAOI activity combined with SNRI causes hypertensive crisis and serotonin syndrome
avoid_supplements.action: Absolutely contraindicated; ensure 14-day washout period between MAOI use and venlafaxine initiation.

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild stimulant properties may potentiate venlafaxine's noradrenergic effects; theoretical risk of increased BP or heart rate
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure and heart rate; use at standard doses only. Patient education on symptom reporting.

caution_supplements.name: Caffeine/Guarana
caution_supplements.mechanism: Stimulant effects may compound venlafaxine-induced tachycardia, tremor, or anxiety; minor CYP1A2 interaction
caution_supplements.action: Limit caffeine intake to <200 mg/day; monitor for increased nervousness or palpitations.

caution_supplements.name: Omega-3 Fatty Acids
caution_supplements.mechanism: Modest antiplatelet effects; venlafaxine may increase bleeding risk at high doses via platelet dysfunction
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for unusual bruising/bleeding; standard doses generally safe; inform if high-dose omega-3 used.

avoid_foods.name: Tyramine-rich foods (if used with MAOI-like activity)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Venlafaxine alone does not require strict tyramine avoidance; however, concern increases with higher doses due to weak MAOI-like activity at doses >300 mg/day
avoid_foods.action: At standard doses, no dietary restriction needed. At high doses, limit aged cheeses, cured meats, fermented foods, soy sauce, and alcohol.

caution_foods.name: Alcohol
caution_foods.mechanism: CNS depressant effects additive with venlafaxine; alcohol may impair judgment and increase sedation; venlafaxine may increase intoxication
caution_foods.action: Limit alcohol consumption; counsel on reduced cognitive/motor performance. Avoid binge drinking.

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/Grapefruit Juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may increase venlafaxine plasma levels; effect is modest given CYP2D6 and CYP2C19 also involved
caution_foods.action: Avoid excessive consumption; if patient desires grapefruit products, monitor for increased side effects (nausea, dizziness, increased BP).

monitoring_notes: Monitor for serotonin syndrome signs (especially if supplements added later), blood pressure, and heart rate at baseline and during therapy. Counsel patients to report all OTC supplements and botanical products; CYP3A4/2D6/2C19 interactions warrant individualized assessment if polypharmacy develops.
